_doc: boatd option presets for boatbench (stack.sh merges one over the bench boatd.json, then BOATBENCH_BOATD_OPTIONS over that). 'untrusted' is components/boat/boatd/untrusted.json (what module.nix untrustedTenants imports) key by key, including memOvercommit: 1 (boatd rejects untrustedTenants with memOvercommit > 1; test_boatbench.py and test_stack_config.py check it against untrusted.json and boatd's loadConfig). stack.sh also turns SMT off (if the host allows it), resolves/creates a dedicated boat-fc group (jailGid), sets kernel.io_uring_disabled=1 + kernel.io_uring_group=jailGid (so jailed Firecracker VMMs keep production Async io_uring I/O while unprivileged processes are blocked) and stops KSM for it, as nixos/profiles/server.nix and module.nix do, and makes the btrfs loop store a sparse 1 TiB file so storageOvercommit 1 admits the bench's VMs (storage admission does not change speed). The historical AX42 Ubuntu run (results/ax42-ubuntu-2026-11-11) used the list before 46507a8 (egressMbit/ingressMbit 1000, diskEngine Sync) and before boatd required memOvercommit <= 1; its boatd_options record it.

untrusted.ioCostQoS: rpct=95 rlat=5000 wpct=95 wlat=10000 min=25 max=400
